messages.subject: Helio MSA — executed
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

I'm pleased to confirm the Master SaaS and Data Services Agreement with Pennine Mutual has been executed today by exchange of signed counterparts. The executed PDF is attached for your records. Final agreed terms: general liability cap 125% of charges in the preceding 12 months; £3,000,000 super-cap for data-protection/confidentiality; £120k implementation fee and £840k year-one subscription (5% annual uplift); 3-year initial term from go-live on 1 May.

Congratulations to the Brightwater team. We'll raise our final invoice and close the file once the implementation fee invoice has gone out.

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0100
